INDIA TO THE WORLD / 3A LOGISTICS

DRIVEN BY PEOPLE WHO CARE

OUR STORY

We started local.
We still care that way.

3A Logistics started with local courier needs: helping people send the things that matter. Today, our Mumbai head office and branches in Kerala, Delhi and Bengaluru connect that local service with international shipping options.

Whether it’s a parcel for family, paperwork for work, or an order from your shop, you can speak with our team about the right option. We’ll explain the packing, documents and next steps before you book.

More offices. A wider reach.
The same personal approach to every parcel.

Our mission

Make sending a parcel easier for everyday people and local businesses, with clear advice and a team they can speak to.

Our vision

Bring people closer to family, friends and customers, wherever their next parcel needs to go.
